title: Conditions to check for Local Cache and Disk Usage

question.author: member_278
question.body: Could support clarify local cache and disk usage in the current CloudBox version? I want to avoid relying on an outdated post.

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Sync Engine documentation says: You can clear it at any time under Settings > Advanced without affecting your files. The cache never counts against your CloudBox storage quota — it is a local, per-device artifact only. The client keeps a local cache of recently changed blocks to make syncs faster; this cache can grow large on busy folders. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
